Subject: Your breach of contract matter - Com. S. No. 1159/2021

Dear Ms. Dutta,

Thank you for meeting us on 28 October 2021 about your dispute with M/s Deshpande Industries. As we understand it, the counterparty terminated the contract without notice. The matter is listed before the Chennai Commercial Court.

Our advice is to send a notice of breach giving the cure period required by the contract. Please collect the contract, the termination letter and the board minutes and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Hema Lakshmanan
